title: Snooze Length and Snooze Count Allowed in Each Class
content:
A host takes a Keyturn Vehicle Listing off the calendar for a while by snoozing it, and each class publishes how long one stretch of snoozing may run and how many stretches a rolling twelve months allows.

| Class | Longest one stretch of snoozing (calendar days) | Stretches allowed in a rolling year |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Economy Class Listing | 60 | 6 |
| Keyturn Standard Class Listing | 60 | 6 |
| Keyturn Premium Class Listing | 45 | 4 |
| Keyturn Luxury Class Listing | 45 | 4 |
| Keyturn Exotic Class Listing | 90 | 8 |
| Keyturn Commercial Van Class Listing | 30 | 4 |

The first column is counted in whole calendar days from the day the listing was snoozed; the second counts stretches, whatever the length of each. The Keyturn Exotic Class Listing carries the longest stretch and the most stretches of the six, 90 calendar days and 8 stretches, and the Keyturn Commercial Van Class Listing the shortest stretch at 30 calendar days.
